title: Capture each optional prop's real internal default value via a @default TSDoc tag, and surface it in Storybook's Controls table Default column
objective: Owner noticed the Controls panel's now-visible 'Default' column (from ARCH-STUDIO-STORYBOOK-REEXAMINE's controls.expanded fix) is empty for every prop, and asked to fix it. Root cause: @example is a seed value for the generated story, not necessarily the component's own real internal default (e.g. Card.shape falls back to 'rectangle' via `props.shape ?? "rectangle"` inside the component, GridLayout.columns falls back to 12) -- this data exists in each component's implementation but was never captured anywhere. Add a new @default TSDoc tag (same parsing convention as @example: inline for simple literals, fenced ```tsx block for anything longer) to every optional prop that has a real internal fallback; export-doc-mesh.mjs captures it into the mesh, generate-stories.mjs emits it as each argType's `table: { defaultValue: { summary: ... } }`.
validations: DONE: read all 7 components' actual implementation code directly (not guessed) to find each optional prop's real internal fallback: Text (tone->"default", strong/truncate->false, maxWidth->"100%" special CSS value), Button (tone->"default"), Card (shape->"rectangle", backgroundColor->"#ffffff", fillContainer/interactive/selected->false, borderWidth->1, borderRadius->8, padding->12), GridLayout (columns->12, rowHeight->32, gap->12), EntitySummary (same Card-forwarded defaults plus contentGap->10, tags->[]), DataTable (pagination->{pageSize:20, hideWhenSinglePage:true}, density->"compact", emptyMessage->"No data"). Deliberately skipped props with no real fallback logic (undefined just means absent) rather than inventing one.

DONE: generalized export-doc-mesh.mjs's example-parsing helper into parseTaggedExpression(blocks, tagName, propName), reused for both @example and the new @default tag (same inline-or-fenced grammar).

DONE: generate-stories.mjs's renderArgType now emits `table: { defaultValue: { summary: ... } }` when a prop has a captured default, collapsing multi-line fenced defaults (DataTable.pagination's object literal) to one line for the table cell.
DONE: regenerated the mesh and printed every captured defaultValue directly -- all 27 expected entries present with exactly the right text, including the collapsed multi-line pagination default.

DONE: packages/ui tsc --noEmit clean, all 9 tests still pass; regenerated all 7 stories, reviewed card.stories.tsx and data-table.stories.tsx directly -- correct table.defaultValue.summary on every relevant argType; architecture-studio's own tsc --noEmit clean.

DONE: confirmed via the live dev server (HMR, no restart needed) that the regenerated story content serves correctly with defaultValue populated; full app chain (/storybook, /storybook-app) still 200.
artifacts: packages/ui/src/{atoms/text.tsx,atoms/button.tsx,atoms/card.tsx,atoms/grid-layout.tsx,molecules/entity-summary.tsx,organisms/data-table.tsx} (@default tags added to props with a real internal fallback)
packages/ui/scripts/export-doc-mesh.mjs (parsePropExample generalized to parseTaggedExpression, reused for @default)
docs/generated/meshes/ui-doc-mesh.v1.json (regenerated, defaultValue field added per prop where applicable)
